app.title: TerraAnáloga
app.tagline: Earth analogs of the Moon and Mars

analogs.placeholderTitle: We are building the analog finder
analogs.placeholderBody: Here you will be able to compare sites on Earth with the Moon and Mars (IFA, zone presets, site cards and radar). It is not available yet; in the meantime, use the Data explorer.

globe.label: 3D globe of the selected body
globe.hint: Drag to rotate · scroll or pinch to zoom · click or tap to move the BBox
globe.noWebgl: Your browser cannot show the 3D globe (WebGL is not available). Switch to the 2D map to continue.
globe.hintShort: Drag to rotate · tap or click to move the BBox
globe.tileErrors: Some detail did not load; showing the base image of the globe.

layers.title: Global layers
layers.hint: Show one variable over the whole visible surface.

unavailable.moon: The Moon has almost no atmosphere, so there is no humidity or rain. Only temperature is available, calculated with a model.
unavailable.mars: This app has no global humidity or rain data for Mars. Only temperature is available, calculated with a model.

sources.temperature: NASA AIRS (Aqua satellite): surface air temperature, daytime pass
sources.humidity: NASA AIRS (Aqua satellite): surface relative humidity, daytime pass
sources.precipitation: NASA GPM IMERG: precipitation rate, one map per day

layers.dateAdjusted: The chosen date ({requested}) is very recent: the latest date that is usually published is shown.
layers.gapsNote: Empty stripes are areas the satellite did not pass over that day.
layers.sourceModel: Approximate model, calculated for this moment ({date} {time} UTC). It is not a measurement or satellite data.
layers.subsolar: Subsolar point (where the Sun is directly overhead): lat. {lat}°, lon. {lon}°

modelNote.moon: The model uses the Sun's position and gives about 390 K under the Sun, about 95 K at night at the equator and about 40 K at the poles. It ignores relief and thermal inertia, and the Sun's position has an error of about 8°.
modelNote.mars: The model uses the Sun's position and gives about 290 K under the Sun and 150–190 K at night. It ignores dust, relief and thermal inertia.

layers.legendLabelLog: Logarithmic scale of {name}: from {min} to {max} {unit} or more
layers.failed: There is no image of this layer for that date (some days are not published). Try another date.

explorer.mapHint: Tap or click the map to move the BBox
explorer.bbox: BBox: coordinate box (min. lon., min. lat., max. lon., max. lat.)

bboxErrors.format: Enter 4 numbers separated by commas, for example: -90.1,13.1,-87.6,14.5.
bboxErrors.range: Adjust the values: longitude ranges from -180 to 180 and latitude from -90 to 90.
bboxErrors.order: Check the order: each minimum must be lower than its maximum.

explorer.dateOrder: Adjust the dates: the start date must be on or before the end date.

result.demoSample: Simulated demo data ({file}): these are not measurements from any mission or from this area. The image is not clipped to the BBox; it is only placed over it.

cryo.title: Simulated example: lunar pole vs. Earth
cryo.lunarMin: Minimum of the simulated profile (Diviner-like): {value} K
cryo.colder: The coldest point of this simulated profile is {delta} K below the Antarctic reference average.
cryo.warmer: The coldest point of this simulated profile is {delta} K above the Antarctic reference average.

results.hint: Choose a scene to locate and process it:
results.empty: No results or source unavailable. Try other dates, another BBox or another filter.

errors.network: We could not reach the data server ({api}). Check that it is running and try again.
errors.timeout: The data server took too long to respond. Please try again in a few seconds.
errors.http: The data server returned an error ({status}): {detail}. Try another scene or try again later.
errors.parse: The data server sent a response we could not read. Please try again.
